title: Draconic Pixelated
description: Pixelated version of all Draconic letters
body:
# Draconic Pixelated - White
## What is Draconic?
Draconic is a conlang made by [human1011](https://www.youtube.com/@humanteneleven), if you want to learn more about it, visit their [Discord](https://discord.gg/By5MxEy6MT)!
## Currntly in the pack:
- Draconic symbols
## Planned in the pack:
- Complete translation of the whole Minecraft to Draconic
## Avaliable symbols: (placed in order of first gallery image)
- _English letter: Draconic letter - Draconic letter name_
- t: t - toru
- c: c - cáll
- k: k - kû
- q: q - qath
- Q: q̇ - q̇os
- \`: \` - ax
- R: tr - trō
- s: s - sēl
- K: kx - khæŋ
- v: qχ - qχē
- w: qħ - qħán
- W: q̇ħ - q̇ħón
- d: d - od
- z: z - ēz
- g: g - āg
- f: f - fe
- T: th - thyn
- L: ll - llī
- x: x - xæ
- X: χ - χy
- h: h - har
- V: χħ - χħáth

- N: ŋ - yŋ
- |: pyr - q̇ħóll
